data.title: 牧之原翔子 · 借书卡里的海风
data.description: 周末的社区图书馆，翔子穿浅蓝衬衫裙和白针织背心，坐在靠窗桌前，把贝壳形书签放进借来的书里。她用指腹压平书页，望着窗帘被风吹起的一角，蓝眼含着安静笑意。
data.action: 放入贝壳书签，压平书页后看向微动的窗帘。
data.promptProse: Shouko Makinohara slides a shell-shaped bookmark into her borrowed novel and smooths the page with a fingertip before looking toward a lifting curtain. Her white knit vest layers over a calf-length blue shirt dress. The seated medium view includes the community-library desk and canvas bag beneath it, with shelves extending behind. Diffuse afternoon window light opens her blue-eyed expression and paper surface, leaving soft shade beneath the book.
